items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: Besides the Fletcher Henderson music, did he put key signatures in the music?

ctx.x: Yeah. Well I’ve got to do it, because I can’t remember all the jigsaw puzzles and all the different parts of Sun Ra because he was always changing stuff. So that left it open to me, whatever — I’m used to it being changed, so I change it.
Besides the Fletcher Henderson music, did he put key signatures in the music?
Yeah. He wrote music like he would write a letter.
